payload.summary: Validation failed: fresh PostgreSQL deployment aborts migration 035 because LOCK TABLE is outside a transaction. Static contracts and affected unit suites passed, but required live smoke, security, and E2E checks could not run; context-impact metadata also failed.

decisions.title: Do not accept degraded live phases
decisions.rationale: The deployable surface failed a real fresh-volume migration and no degraded-phase authorization exists.

next_steps: Re-run live PostgreSQL, smoke, security, and E2E validation
